verdict.rationale: Statsig's docs show attribute-based targeting on feature gates, such as targeting mobile platforms and internal testers in the first-feature tutorial. They also describe layering multiple targeting rules and setting overrides to force specific users into a variant. Nothing in the pack documents reusable segments, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented reusable segments shared across flags, detail on supported attributes and rule operators, independent or hands-on corroboration of targeting.
